theorems.name: Submission.bv_isOpen_exists_compact_exhaustion
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : Set (Rn n)), IsOpen U → ∃ Q : ℕ → Set (Rn n), (∀ j, IsCompact (Q j)) ∧ (∀ j, Q j ⊆ U) ∧ Monotone Q ∧ ∀ K : Set (Rn n), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ j, K ⊆ Q j
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
